intro: Across 33 articles published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-10-02, ZCyberNews tracked privilege-escalation activity spanning technology, enterprise, government, healthcare, and education. Coverage centered on Global, Brazil, France, Germany, and India. Chaotic Eclipse and Lazarus Group were the most frequently cited threat actors. Five CVEs anchored the reporting: CVE-2026-8950, CVE-2026-8956, and CVE-2026-8957, each rated CVSS 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34659 and CVE-2026-34660 at CVSS 9.6. The severity mix comprised 23 high, 5 critical, and 3 medium items across the period.
